invented.quote: The last supply boat has gone. The sea is freezing at the edges. Between now and the spring thaw, your family has to keep the lamp lit, the larder full and each other going.
invented.why: The brief only states that you see a lighthouse keeper's family through a winter, without giving these specific story or gameplay elements.

invented.quote: Every choice is a trade-off: oil for the lamp or fuel for the stove, mending the roof or watching the water. Storms come in, supplies run out, and the ships out in the dark rely on you.
invented.why: The brief does not mention any of these specific game mechanics, resources, tasks or events.

invented.quote: I've spent the past three years making sure this game holds up.
invented.why: The brief says playtesting has run since 2023, which does not establish a three-year timeframe without a current date.

invented.quote: from seasoned hobbyists to people who rarely play board games
invented.why: The brief only says there were about 60 different people, without describing their experience with board games.

invented.quote: with strangers sitting down to play and giving honest feedback
invented.why: The brief states the game was taken to two conventions, but does not say who played it there or what feedback they gave.

invented.quote: from the first 23 players who rated it on BoardGameGeek
invented.why: The brief refers only to 'the main board game ratings site' rather than naming BoardGameGeek, and does not specify that the 23 raters were the 'first' to rate it.

invented.quote: Every one of those sessions changed something, whether a rule, a card or a balance tweak.
invented.why: The brief does not state that every playtest session resulted in changes, nor does it say that the game includes cards.

invented.quote: The version you'll get has been through the hands of dozens of players who weren't shy about telling me what didn't work.
invented.why: The brief gives the number of playtesters and sessions, but says nothing about how critical the playtesters were.

invented.quote: What I can offer is a game I've rebuilt dozens of times because I wanted it to be right, and a commitment to tell you plainly how the project is going at every stage.
invented.why: The brief does not say that the creator rebuilt the game dozens of times or made this specific communication commitment.

invented.quote: Reaching the goal covers manufacturing, shipping to backers and platform fees.
invented.why: The brief provides quotes for manufacturing and shipping, but does not mention platform fees or state what the $28,000 goal covers.

invented.quote: Throughout the campaign and production, I'll post regular updates with photos from the factory, so you'll always know where your copy is.
invented.why: The brief says nothing about posting updates or obtaining photos from the factory.
